final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: sink IREF with diode-connected nfet
MB  ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
* tail current source
M5  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=8 L=1
* input pair (vinp -> M1, vinn -> M2)
M1  x     vinp  tail vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
M2  d2    vinn  tail vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
* PMOS mirror load, diode on the vinn side -> x is inverting w.r.t. vinp
M3  d2    d2    vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1
M4  x     d2    vdd  vdd pfet W=6 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink
M6  vout  x     vdd  vdd pfet W=30 L=0.5
M7  vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=28 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  x     cz    2000
Cc  cz    vout  1e-12
.ends dut
